utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep an ear out for the time and place, and I’ll pass along the latest needs as soon as I know them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for your update on the time, place, and current needs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll let you know the time, place, and what they still need as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can drop off some tape, and I’ll see if I can find a hammer too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Bo — tape and a hammer would help a lot. Drop them off whenever you can, and I’ll keep track of the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by with the tape, and I’ll bring the hammer if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes please—I’d love to add you, and just so you know, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that works for me. What do you want me to handle first at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—could you start by checking in helpers and setting up the tools table? I’ll keep spreading the invite from here.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—it's still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on today. I’m available, and I can bring the drill and a screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks—just wanted to make sure. I may need help with a loose cabinet hinge and a wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that helps. I’ll wait for your update so we can avoid any last-minute gaps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll make sure you get the update right away, and I’ll confirm the drop-off time so we stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Once you confirm the drop-off time, I can help make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the time and meeting spot before I confirm anything for the repair drive. Could you remind me what time and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — it’s at 10 a.m. by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — 10 a.m. at the community center entrance works for me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli. If you can bring the supply list a little early, I’ll check what’s still missing when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that—what time should I bring the supply list by?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Could you bring it by around 2:30? That’ll give me time to check what’s missing before we start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I can still sort the donated tools and help at the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam—thank you! Sunday at the community center it is, and sorting the donated tools plus the sign-in table will be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Tess—I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll add you to the list. Thanks for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll be there and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Uli — I’ve got you on the list, and I’ll keep everyone posted about the Sunday community center location.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring my hands and see if I can find a screwdriver or some tape. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds perfect, Mina—your helping hands and whatever screwdriver or tape you can find is plenty. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, see you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — I’ll let you know who’s available and what tools they can lend as soon as I confirm. The repair drive is still on for today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure — thanks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check in and send you the update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep the screws, paint brushes, and heavy-duty tape ready, and we’ll sort everything out when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’m checking our tools and spare parts now, and I should be there a bit late with whatever I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem, Dane — I’ll keep everything organized and ready, and we can sort the tools and spare parts as soon as you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’ll see you there and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Uli — I’ve put you on the list. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list organized. If you can, help gather any remaining addresses and I’ll sort out what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll gather the remaining addresses and keep sharing the update for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — thank you. I’ll keep the list updated and let everyone know what still needs to be brought for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — could you remind me what tools or supplies you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly screws, a drill, and a couple replacement parts. If you spot anything else useful, just send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for screws, a drill, and any spare parts. If I hear of anything else useful, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem at all — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know as soon as I have the time and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate you asking around. Just let me know the time and meeting spot when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll keep an ear out and pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring the tools I promised and meet you wherever the group sets up, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’m still confirming the time and meeting spot for the repair drive, then I’ll let you know where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana—just send me the time and place when it’s set, and I’ll be there with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll check which homes need the most urgent repairs and write down their addresses.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Rey — focus on the urgent ones first and bring the list to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll focus on the urgent ones and bring the list to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at 3:00 with the broken item and any parts I have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Eli—3:00 works great. If you have any charger or the original packaging, bring that too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Faye. I’ll bring the broken item, any charger, and the original packaging if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll set up the table and greet folks when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Leo — that covers the table and welcoming folks. If you can also keep an eye on the tools table later, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll keep an eye on the tools table too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Saturday at 10 works for me. I’ll bring a few supplies and help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Faye—Saturday at 10 it is, and I’ll have the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday at 10 with supplies and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the north entrance by the community center parking lot on the Maple Park side — got it. I’m heading that way now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — that’s the right way in. I’ll keep an eye out by the north entrance if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, I’m almost there. If I miss you, I’ll just circle back to the north entrance by the parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — I’ll check the tools list on the table and help confirm the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks—if you confirm the time, I’ll finish sorting the boxes and stack the labeled ones by the door so we don’t fall behind.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it, Pia — I’ll confirm the drop-off time and keep an eye on the table list. Thanks for staying on top of the boxes!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — Noah, head to the community center by Maple Park and check in there, and I’ll point you to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll head to the community center by Maple Park and check in when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll be at the tools table, and I’ll send you over once you check in.
